spine: 1. DBOS 的 Postgres-backed workflow 佇列要從約 100 個 workflow 每秒撐到 30,000 個以上，靠的是三個疊加的 SQL 層機制修正，不是換資料庫。
2. 第一個瓶頸：naive dequeue 查詢讓所有 worker 撈到同一批最舊列，大部分 worker 白跑重試；SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED 讓每個 worker 只拿『還沒被鎖住』的最舊列，鎖定與跳過兩件事同時發生。
3. 修完鎖競爭後，約 1,000 個每秒撞上第二瓶頸：REPEATABLE READ 底下多 worker 修改重疊列會觸發序列化失敗，規模化後重試耗時超過實際處理時間。
4. 修法不是整體降級成 READ COMMITTED，而是條件式：需要全域併發上限的佇列留在 REPEATABLE READ，不需要的改用 READ COMMITTED，徹底消除序列化失敗。
5. 修完隔離等級後，約 8,000 個每秒撞上第三瓶頸：CPU 而非鎖或重試——每次狀態變化都要維護每一個索引，加上 autovacuum 清理消耗大量 CPU。
6. 修法是部分索引：只對 status = 'ENQUEUED' 的列建索引，dequeue 查詢省掉排序步驟，且列一旦被 dequeue 索引項就直接刪除，不必維護到 workflow 生命週期結束。
7. 三個機制疊加把吞吐量從約 100 個每秒推到 30,000 個以上、約 800 億次每月，橫跨數千台伺服器——任何一層拿掉，對應的瓶頸就會回來。

perspective.mechanism: DBOS 展示如何用三個疊加的 Postgres 機制——SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED 鎖定跳過、依佇列是否需要全域流控條件式選用交易隔離等級、只涵蓋 ENQUEUED 狀態列的部分索引——把單一資料庫佇列從約 100 個 workflow 每秒撐到 30,000 個以上。
perspective.tradeoff: 每個修法都用局部代價換吞吐量：SKIP LOCKED 犧牲嚴格的『最舊優先』保證，換不必要的等待；READ COMMITTED 犧牲全域一致快照，換掉序列化失敗與重試；部分索引犧牲對非 ENQUEUED 狀態列的索引覆蓋，換掉索引維護與 autovacuum 開銷。
perspective.reader_use: 自己拿 Postgres 當佇列用的工程師，可以照這三個檢查點回頭看：dequeue 查詢有沒有 SKIP LOCKED、交易隔離等級是不是預設用了比實際需求高的等級、索引有沒有還在替『已經處理完』的列維護。

notes.quote: Locking clauses make Postgres-backed queues possible (which is why SKIP LOCKED is one of those old Postgres tricks that keeps getting rediscovered). Without them, contention between workers prevents scaling beyond ~100 workflows per second.
notes.interpretation: SKIP LOCKED 被定位為必要前提而非最佳化選項；沒有它，吞吐量卡在約 100 個 workflow 每秒的基準線。

notes.quote: Every worker sees the same oldest queued workflows and attempts to dequeue them at the same time.
notes.interpretation: 問題成因：naive dequeue 查詢排序後，所有 worker 撈到同一批最舊列。

notes.quote: But each workflow can only be dequeued by a single worker, so most workers will fail to find new work and have to try again.
notes.interpretation: 上一句成因的直接後果：大部分 worker 白跑一趟、形成無謂重試。

notes.quote: Selecting rows in this way does two things. First, it locks the rows so that other workers cannot also select them. Second, it skips rows that are already locked, selecting not the N oldest enqueued workflows, but the N oldest enqueued workflows that are not already locked by another worker.
notes.interpretation: SKIP LOCKED 機制拆解：鎖定＋跳過已鎖定列兩件事合起來，讓每個 worker 拿到的其實是『還沒被別人鎖住的最舊 N 筆』而非固定的『最舊 N 筆』。

notes.quote: The dequeue transaction originally ran at REPEATABLE READ so it could support global queue limits like 'run at most N workflows concurrently across all workers.'
notes.interpretation: 選用 REPEATABLE READ 的原始理由：要支援跨 worker 的全域併發上限。

notes.quote: If multiple workers concurrently modify overlapping rows, Postgres aborts one of them with a serialization failure.
notes.interpretation: REPEATABLE READ 在高併發下的代價：重疊列修改觸發序列化失敗，必須重試整筆交易。

notes.quote: When dequeueing more than ~1000 workflows per second, the majority of dequeue operations encountered serialization failures, creating a performance bottleneck.
notes.interpretation: 具體門檻：約 1,000 個每秒之後，序列化失敗開始佔多數，形成第二個瓶頸。

notes.quote: At scale, workers spent more time retrying transactions than processing workflows.
notes.interpretation: 序列化失敗在規模化後的具體代價：重試耗時超過真正處理時間。

notes.quote: Queues with global flow control continue using REPEATABLE READ, while queues without it use READ COMMITTED, which eliminates serialization failures entirely and dramatically improves throughput.
notes.interpretation: 修法是條件式交易隔離：非全域限制的佇列改用 READ COMMITTED，徹底避免序列化失敗。

notes.quote: However, when running more than ~8000 workflows per second, we saw a new bottleneck: high CPU usage.
notes.interpretation: 修完隔離等級後，新瓶頸浮現在約 8,000 個每秒，轉為 CPU 而非鎖等待。

notes.quote: Every workflow status update (enqueue, dequeue, completion) requires updating every index. Moreover, after indexes are updated, Postgres autovacuum has to clean up outdated index entries. At high throughput, index maintenance and vacuuming consume a substantial fraction of database CPU.
notes.interpretation: CPU 瓶頸成因：每次狀態轉換都要維護每一個索引，加上 autovacuum 清理，兩者疊加吃掉大量 CPU。

notes.quote: This improves performance for two reasons. First, the dequeue query no longer needs an expensive sort step. Second, when the workflow is dequeued, Postgres can simply delete its index entry instead of maintaining it for the rest of the workflow's lifetime, reducing maintenance and auto-vacuum cost.
notes.interpretation: 部分索引（只索引 ENQUEUED 列）的效果：省掉排序步驟，且列被 dequeue 後索引項直接被刪除，而不是繼續維護到 workflow 生命週期結束。

notes.quote: In this blog post, we'll show how we optimized Postgres-backed queues at scale, achieving 30K workflow executions per second across thousands of servers.
notes.interpretation: 最終達成的吞吐量與部署規模：30K workflow 每秒，橫跨數千台伺服器。

notes.quote: Combined, these optimizations cut CPU usage dramatically, allowing queues to scale to over 30K workflows per second, or 80B per month.
notes.interpretation: 三個機制合起來的總效果，換算成月執行量約 800 億次。

notes.quote: Lesson 1: (Re-)Discovering SKIP LOCKED / Lesson 2: Mind the Transaction Isolation Levels / Lesson 3: Indexes Aren't Free
notes.interpretation: 文章的三段標題結構，確認三個機制對應三個獨立小節（依序：SKIP LOCKED、交易隔離等級、索引），支撐本文以三個 H2 對應三段的結構安排。
